<!--
  What HeroSplit shows under the lead: three figures in cards, a row of faces with a proof line, two small
  feature cards, or a quote with its author over three figures.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeroContent } from "../blocks/hero-split.types";

  export type HeroSplitExtrasProps = {
    content: HeroContent;
    extra?: "stats" | "avatars" | "minis" | "quote" | "none";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";

  let { content, extra = "none" }: HeroSplitExtrasProps = $props();
</script>

{#if (((extra as string) === "stats") && ((content.stats?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="hero-stats">
    {#each content.stats as s, i (s.id)}
      {#if (i < 3)}
        <Stack gap="0" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="hero-stat">
          <Text size="2xl" weight="semibold">
            {s.value}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {s.label}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if (((extra as string) === "avatars") && ((content.people?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
  <Group gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap" data-testid="hero-proof">
    <Group gap="2" align="center">
      {#each content.people as p, i (p.id)}
        {#if (i < 4)}
          <MediaFrame alt={p.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Group>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {content.proof}
    </Text>
  </Group>
{/if}
{#if (((extra as string) === "minis") && ((content.features?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2" data-testid="hero-minis">
    {#each content.features as f, i (f.id)}
      {#if (i < 2)}
        <Group gap="4" align="start" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="hero-mini">
          <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
            <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={20} />
          </Box>
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {f.title}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {f.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if (((extra as string) === "quote") && ((content.people?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
  <Stack gap="6" align="stretch">
    {#each content.people as p, i (p.id)}
      {#if (i < 1)}
        <FigureBlock class="flex flex-col gap-4" testid="hero-quote">
          <Text tag="blockquote" class="text-lg font-medium">
            {p.quote}
          </Text>
          <Group gap="4" align="center">
            <MediaFrame alt={p.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {p.author}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {p.role}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        </FigureBlock>
      {/if}
    {/each}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="hero-stats">
      {#each content.stats as s, i (s.id)}
        {#if (i < 3)}
          <Stack gap="0" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="hero-stat">
            <Text size="2xl" weight="semibold">
              {s.value}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {s.label}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Box>
  </Stack>
{/if}
